name: AnonAddy
requires: Requires a separate MySQL and Redis server. See documentation: https://github.com/anonaddy/anonaddy/blob/master/SELF-HOSTING.md

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: The URL to the AnonAddy server

variables.name: MySQL - Host
variables.description: The host for the MySQL database connection

variables.name: MySQL - Port
variables.description: The port for the MySQL database connection

variables.name: MySQL - Username
variables.description: The username for the MySQL database connection

variables.name: MySQL - Password
variables.description: The password for the MySQL database connection

variables.name: MySQL - Database
variables.description: The name of the MySQL database

variables.name: Redis - Host
variables.description: The host for the Redis connection

variables.name: Redis - Port
variables.description: The port for the Redis connection

variables.name: Redis - Password
variables.description: The password for the Redis connection. Use 'null' to not set.

variables.name: Outgoing Mail - From Name
variables.description: The name to use when sending emails

variables.name: Outgoing Mail - From Address
variables.description: The email address to use when sending emails

variables.name: Outgoing Mail - Host
variables.description: The host for the mail server connection

variables.name: Outgoing Mail - Port
variables.description: The port for the mail server connection. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Outgoing Mail - Encryption
variables.description: The encryption for the mail server connection

variables.name: Outgoing Mail - EHLO Host
variables.description: The EHLO host for the mail server connection

variables.name: Outgoing Mail - Verify Peer
variables.description: Verify the peer when connecting to the mail server

variables.name: AnonAddy - Return Email
variables.description: The SMTP FROM address to be used if the alias address cannot be, e.g. for a custom domain that is not verified for sending

variables.name: AnonAddy - Admin Username
variables.description: The username for the admin account

variables.name: AnonAddy - Enable Registration
variables.description: Allow users to register

variables.name: AnonAddy - Domain
variables.description: The domain to use for the AnonAddy server

variables.name: AnonAddy - Hostname
variables.description: The hostname to use for the AnonAddy server

variables.name: AnonAddy - DNS Resolver
variables.description: The DNS resolver to use for the AnonAddy server

variables.name: AnonAddy - All Domains
variables.description: Comma-separated list of all domains to use for the AnonAddy server

variables.name: AnonAddy - Secret
variables.description: The secret to use for the AnonAddy server. Run `openssl rand -base64 32` to generate.

variables.name: AnonAddy - Email Limit
variables.description: Number of emails that can be forwarded through the service per hour by any one user

variables.name: AnonAddy - Bandwidth Limit
variables.description: Monthly bandwidth limit, in bytes

variables.name: AnonAddy - Alias Limit
variables.description: Number of new aliases that can be created per hour

variables.name: AnonAddy - Additional Username Limit
variables.description: Number of additional usernames that can be added

variables.name: AnonAddy - Private Key Fingerprint
variables.description: Fingerprint of the private key that you generated on the server to be used to sign encrypted forwarded emails

variables.name: App Name
variables.description: The name of the app

variables.name: App Environment
variables.description: The environment the app is running in

variables.name: Enable Debugging
variables.description: Enable debugging

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: The log level

variables.name: DKIM Signing Key
variables.description: Only needed if you plan to add any custom domains through the web application. See documentation: https://github.com/anonaddy/anonaddy/blob/master/SELF-HOSTING.md

variables.name: Log Channel
variables.description: The log channel

variables.name: Database Connection
variables.description: The database connection. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Redis Client
variables.description: The Redis client. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Mail Driver
variables.description: The mail driver. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: DKIM Selector
variables.description: The DKIM selector. Not recommended to change.

author: nwithan8
